question: Evaluate: 6 - [(2)/(3) div left{(1)/(6) + ((1)/(2) times (1 - (1)/(3)))right}]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to BODMAS, solve inner brackets first: (1 − 1/3) = 2/3

Multiply inner terms: 1/2 × 2/3 = 1/3

Solve curly brackets: 1/6 + 1/3 = 1/2

Solve square brackets: 2/3 ÷ 1/2 = 2/3 × 2 = 4/3

Final subtraction: 6 − 4/3 = 14/3

**∴ The correct answer is 14/3.**
